investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity on All Available Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api because every pod submitted for remote agent creation was left unschedulable: the 2 nodes carrying the kata.peerpods.io/vm resource reported insufficient capacity, and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity or selector. No evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected because the pod never reached a running state within the eval timeout window.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents feature has exhausted its kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the 2 nodes that carry it. Of the 6 total nodes, 4 are ineligible due to node affinity or selector mismatch, leaving only those 2 kata-capable nodes to serve all remote agent pods. At the time of the eval run, both of those nodes reported "Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm" and preemption found no victims, so every new pod remained Unschedulable for the full ~135–145 s eval window. This is an eval-detected infrastructure capacity constraint; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
